correctness.rationale: Conditional on median occupancy, distinct outward components are independent, with a median observable itself deterministic if measured. The one-step conditional slope along an edge is a strictly negative conditional occupancy probability and these slopes multiply along a path by the tree Markov property. Centering each affine conditional expectation gives the product of the slopes times the third centered Bernoulli moment p(1-p)(1-2p). Thus only the sign of the root-occupied minus root-empty partition polynomial, up to fixed parity, can vary at positive fugacity. I independently enumerated unrooted trees by adjoining a leaf at one representative of each vertex orbit and canonicalizing by the least rooted parenthesis code. Removing a leaf proves exhaustion; sorted recursive codes characterize rooted isomorphism, so they also distinguish marked vertex orbits. A separate independent-set inclusion/exclusion traversal computed the occupied and empty counts by size; it gave 4765 median-eligible marked types (root degree at least two), the stated rooted counts, and exactly the two listed Descartes exceptions. Both exceptions are strictly negative for positive lambda: their last three terms are respectively -lambda^4[(lambda-1)^2+16] and -lambda^4[(lambda-2)^2+10], with earlier terms negative. All other polynomials have at most one positive root by Descartes. The witness gives the two stated coefficient vectors, and P(3),P(4),P(14),P(15) = -1474,13747,1244837,-8562766. Two Descartes variations and two disjoint sign-crossing intervals imply exactly two simple positive roots. The two off-median measured sites each have distance two, so the cumulant sign is minus the polynomial sign. The two stated approximations agree with interval bisection.
residual_risks: The lower bound exhausts orders 1–12, not all witnesses of order 13 or any scope beyond finite trees with a common activity. The root approximations are not used in the sign proof.

value.rationale: This is a sharp obstruction and construction for a natural equilibrium observable: tree two-point covariance has a fixed distance-parity sign, but the third centered joint moment can reverse twice even with one homogeneous activity. Knowing the least possible order distinguishes a genuine branching-tree nonlinear response from merely observing one example; the explicit sign intervals make the witness reusable without a numerical scan.
residual_risks: A finite-size analytic effect only; no inference about phase transitions or arbitrary larger-tree cumulant patterns.
